totalAccepted.reason: Category 1 approved by ACCME, AOA or AAPA, as the app names them.

notes.text: Up to 25 hours over the 50 may carry over to the next period.

condition.question: Do you prescribe controlled substances?

agreement.text: A PA practices under the supervision of a physician who is party to a collaborative agreement with the PA, kept at each practice site and given to the board on request.

cycleYears.reason: PA licenses expire October 1 of odd-numbered years: every two years.

unverified: Whether PAs need a state controlled substance registration (the statement that Nebraska issues none is on the nursing page)

board.name: Nebraska DHHS Licensure Unit, Nebraska State Board of Nursing / APRN Board

cycleYears.reason: RN licenses expire October 31 of each even-numbered year.

options.text: At least 500 hours of nursing practice in the past five years and at least 20 contact hours in the past two years
Current certification in a nursing specialty from a nationally recognized certifying organization
Graduated from a nursing program more than two but less than five years ago, and at least 20 contact hours in the past two years
Graduated from a nursing program within the last two years
An approved refresher course within the last five years
A continuing competency portfolio with current goals and evidence of activities toward them

exemption.field: Received the RN license within the past 24 months
exemption.question: Did you receive this RN license within the past 24 months?
exemption.text: A nurse who received the license within the past 24 months needs no continuing education for this renewal.

cycleYears.reason: RN licenses expire October 31 of each even-numbered year: every two years.

ce.reason: Renewal requires current national certification in the NP specialty and practice hours; no APRN contact hours are set.

cycleYears.reason: APRN licenses expire October 31 of each even-numbered year.

practiceHours.label: If licensed more than five years: at least 2,080 hours of NP practice in the five years before renewal

topics.label: Opiate prescribing, including half an hour on the prescription drug monitoring program, for renewals through 2028

condition.question: Do you prescribe controlled substances?
condition.description: Applies to clinicians who prescribe controlled substances.

cycleYears.reason: APRN licenses expire October 31 of each even-numbered year: every two years.

agreement.text: A new NP practices the first 2,000 hours under a written transition-to-practice agreement with a supervising physician or experienced NP in the same or a related specialty; the agreement goes to DHHS only on request.
